Subject: Refund never arrived
Description: I returned my widget 3 weeks ago and still no refund on my card.
Resolution: Confirmed warehouse scan on day 2, refund processed to original payment method within the 5-7 business day window.

Subject: Want a refund for one item in my order
Description: I ordered 3 widgets and want to return 1 for a refund.
Resolution: Processed a partial refund for one unit minus the 10% restocking fee.

Subject: Refund request past 14 days
Description: It's been 20 days since delivery, can I still get a refund?
Resolution: Declined refund as outside the 14-day window; offered defect diagnostic instead since customer mentioned it stopped working.

Subject: Asked for cash instead of store credit
Description: I want my refund back on my card, not store credit.
Resolution: Switched refund method to original payment; advised 5-7 business day timeline.

Subject: Refund shows as pending for 2 weeks
Description: My refund status has said pending for two weeks now with no movement.
Resolution: Escalated to L2 billing after confirming warehouse receipt was over 10 business days old; payment processor had failed silently and had to be re-triggered manually by finance.

Subject: Return shipped but refund not started
Description: Tracking says delivered to your warehouse 4 days ago, no refund yet.
Resolution: Explained the warehouse scan can lag carrier delivery by up to 2 business days; advised to wait, refund started before ticket closed.

Subject: Billed twice this month
Description: I see two charges from Acme this month, is this a duplicate?
Resolution: Checked order history and found the two charges were an initial order plus a subscription renewal, not a duplicate; explained the billing cycle.

Subject: Need invoice with updated company address
Description: Our finance team needs the last invoice reissued with our new billing address.
Resolution: Declined editing the original invoice since it's over 90 days old; explained past invoices are immutable after that window.

Subject: Missing invoice PDF
Description: I never got the invoice email for my last order.
Resolution: Resent the invoice PDF from the account portal and confirmed the billing contact email was correct.

Subject: Tax charged despite exemption certificate
Description: We have a tax exemption on file but got charged tax on our last 2 orders.
Resolution: Confirmed exemption was approved after those invoices were issued; explained exemptions aren't retroactive and future orders will be exempt.

Subject: Order stuck in transit for a week
Description: My tracking hasn't updated in 8 business days.
Resolution: Confirmed it was within the 10-business-day threshold; advised to wait for carrier to catch up on backlog.

Subject: Package way overdue
Description: It has been 3 weeks since I ordered and tracking is frozen.
Resolution: Opened a carrier trace since it was 12 business days past the quoted window, and shipped a free replacement immediately per policy.

Subject: Wrong address caused a return
Description: My package got sent back to Acme because I had a typo in my address.
Resolution: Explained this is not a covered delay and re-shipped at customer's expense once the correct address was confirmed.

Subject: Expedited shipping took too long
Description: I paid for 2-3 day shipping but it's been 6 business days.
Resolution: Confirmed order was outside the expedited window, opened a carrier trace, and refunded the shipping fee difference as a goodwill gesture beyond standard policy - required a manager approval outside the normal single-reply flow.

Subject: No movement on tracking at all
Description: Tracking number was generated 10 days ago but shows no scans.
Resolution: Confirmed no carrier movement past the 10-business-day mark, opened a trace and offered immediate free replacement.

Subject: Delivery delayed by weather
Description: Carrier says delayed due to weather, what happens now?
Resolution: Advised this is a normal carrier delay within policy and to wait for the backlog to clear.

Subject: Widget arrived crushed
Description: The box was crushed and the widget inside is in pieces.
Resolution: Sent a free replacement same day after receiving photos, no return required since order was under $150.

Subject: Two items damaged in one order
Description: Both widgets I ordered arrived with visible impact damage.
Resolution: Replaced both damaged units in a single shipment rather than splitting into two orders.

Subject: High value order arrived dented
Description: My $200 widget bundle arrived with a dented box and one unit is cracked.
Resolution: Shipped replacement with a prepaid return label since order was over $150, and explained the 14-day return window for the damaged unit.

Subject: Packaging fine but widget doesn't turn on
Description: Box looked perfect but the widget won't power on at all.
Resolution: Reclassified as a product defect rather than transit damage since packaging was undamaged; routed through the standard defect diagnostic instead.

Subject: Locked out, reset email never came
Description: I requested a password reset but never got the email.
Resolution: Found a typo in the email on file, corrected it, and resent the reset link.

Subject: Lost my 2FA device
Description: I got a new phone and lost access to my authenticator app.
Resolution: Verified identity via billing zip and last 4 of the card on file before disabling 2FA on the account.

Subject: Someone else placed orders on my account
Description: There are orders in my history I never placed.
Resolution: Locked the account immediately as containment, then proceeded with identity verification to restore access safely.

Subject: Accidentally made two accounts
Description: I signed up twice by mistake and now my orders are split.
Resolution: Explained Acme does not support merging accounts and recorded the newer account as primary going forward.

Subject: 2FA reset requested over chat only
Description: Customer asked to disable 2FA just by describing their order history verbally.
Resolution: Declined to disable 2FA without the required billing zip and last-4 verification; case required a supervisor call back since the customer could not complete verification in one session.

Subject: Widget won't power on
Description: My widget is completely dead, doesn't respond to charging.
Resolution: Walked through the standard diagnostic (cable, outlet, reset hold) and authorized a defect replacement after customer confirmed no success.

Subject: Replacement unit failed again within a month
Description: The replacement widget you sent me stopped working after 3 weeks.
Resolution: Escalated to L2 engineering to flag a possible batch defect rather than issuing a second like-for-like replacement.

Subject: Small scuff on the trim
Description: There's a tiny cosmetic scuff on the side of my widget.
Resolution: Explained cosmetic marks that don't affect function are not covered under the defect policy.

Subject: Widget defective after 13 months
Description: My widget stopped working, I bought it about 13 months ago.
Resolution: Explained the 12-month defect window had passed and routed the case to L2 engineering for a case-by-case decision.

Subject: Charging cable seems loose
Description: Widget only charges if I hold the cable at a weird angle.
Resolution: Confirmed with customer that reseating the cable and trying a different outlet resolved the issue; no replacement needed.
